commons.title: Gyani Maiya Sen Kusunda-"Gyani Maiya" (2019 documentary).jpg
commons.description: Gyani Maiya Sen Kusunda during the filming of 2019 documentary film "Gyani Maiya". Sen-Kusunda was one of the two fluent native speakers of the Kusunda language. The film was shot in Kulmor, Dang district, Nepal, and was directed by Subhashish Panigrahi.
commons.editorial_reason: Portrait of a named Kusunda language speaker, but she is shown in ordinary modern clothing with no visible traditional cultural dress, adornment, craft, performance, architecture, or attributed objects.
